integrity_statement: The complete parameter proof is analytic, finite test computations are supplementary, and originality is assessed by cited-source implication comparisons rather than by claimed exhaustive literature uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Only one-point additions to two-cluster finite ultrametric sources with positive homogeneous intracluster distances at most the cross-cluster distance; real Banach targets; no uniqueness claim among nonsymmetric operators; independent audit not performed.
title: A three-regime exact one-point Lipschitz extension law for two-cluster ultrametrics
